about: ElevenLabs narration v3, voice 'Max – Elearning and Documentary' (original file ElevenLabs_2026-10-19T12_37_34_Max_-_Elearning_and_Documentary_pvc_sp100_s50_sb75_v4_1.mp3): one continuous 59.2 s read of VO script v3 (Doc JD's revisions: VO-05 'Four years of satellite radar observations, unified.', VO-16 'Project LInOG. Towards nationwide ground deformation detection from space.'), 44.1 kHz mono MP3. `node tools/vo.js --take vo/source/elevenlabs_max_take2.json --force` cuts it into the 16 cue lines and writes vo/vo.wav with each line's first word on its cue `in` (src/vo_cues.js).
how: src: the source window [s, e] holding exactly one line, cut in the silence between lines (mid-pause). parts: how many speech runs the line has (runs split by pauses of 0.15 s or more); the tool stops if it finds a different count. pauses: optional target length (s) for each pause inside the line, in order; null keeps it as read. This read is slower than take 1, so the opening lines' comma pauses are tightened (VO-02, VO-03) to fit before the 10 s hit, and VO-09 and VO-11 lose a little of their inner pause so they finish clear of the 30 s and 42 s hits.
